title: Best pitcher I've ever owned!
text: Best pitcher I've ever owned!. The perfect addition to any home! I recommend this pitcher 100%, but mostly if you are sure you will never ever drop this, it looks amazing and works perfectly but I'd probably die if it ever fell down, by itself it is very lightweight and delicate I'm sure it could break easily. Other than that this is the perfect carafe I personally love it and both my husband and I fell in love with it after using it for a while, I have used it for tea, cold drinks, juices, fruit water and everything. It may not be so easy to clean if you don't have the proper cleaning tools but if you do it is a breeze to clean I have never tried to wash it on the dishwasher but only because I want to preserve it as it is and I'm not sure if it is dishwasher safe but I prefer to wash it by hand, specially the top part. It is very easy to serve and reuse even. I am in love with this and got another one for the heck of it.
